Read the following product demo script and answer the questions.

Demo Script:

"Good morning everyone. Today I'm going to show you our new analytics dashboard. This tool helps businesses track their key performance indicators in real-time.

First, let me log in. As you can see, the dashboard loads within 2 seconds. The main view shows an overview of your most important metrics. You can customize this view by clicking on the 'Edit Dashboard' button.

One of the key features is the ability to create custom reports. Let me show you how it works. I'll click on 'Reports', then 'Create New Report'. I can select the metrics I want, set a date range, and choose the chart type. The report is generated instantly and can be exported as a PDF.

You can also set up alerts. When a metric crosses a threshold, you'll receive an email notification. This is very useful for monitoring performance.

To conclude, this dashboard is designed to be intuitive and powerful. You can try it yourself with a free trial. Thank you for your attention. I'm happy to answer any questions."

questions.texte: What is the purpose of the dashboard being demonstrated?
questions.reponse: The dashboard helps businesses track their key performance indicators in real-time.

questions.texte: List two key features mentioned in the demo.
questions.reponse: 1. Ability to create custom reports; 2. Setting up alerts for metric thresholds.

questions.texte: How can a user customize the dashboard view?
questions.reponse: By clicking on the 'Edit Dashboard' button.

questions.texte: What options does the user have when creating a custom report?
questions.reponse: They can select metrics, set a date range, and choose the chart type.

questions.texte: What is the presenter's closing statement?
questions.reponse: The presenter says the dashboard is designed to be intuitive and powerful, invites the audience to try it, and offers to answer questions.

enonce.texte:
Work with a partner. One person is the presenter, the other is a potential client.

Scenario: You are demoing a new project management tool called 'TaskFlow'. Features include:

  • Task creation and assignment
  • Real-time progress tracking
  • Team collaboration (comments and file sharing)
  • Integration with Slack and Google Calendar

The presenter must give a 3-5 minute demo, explaining each feature.

The client must ask at least 3 questions about the features, pricing, or security.

Write the dialogue of your demo.

questions.texte: Write the dialogue of your product demo.
questions.reponse: Presenter: Hello everyone! Today I'm going to show you TaskFlow, our new project management tool. Let me start by logging in. As you can see, the dashboard is clean and intuitive. You can create tasks by clicking the 'New Task' button. You can assign tasks to team members, set deadlines, and add descriptions. Client: Can I see how team collaboration works? Presenter: Sure. You can add comments to any task. You can also attach files. The whole team can see updates in real-time. Client: That's great. Does it integrate with other tools? Presenter: Yes, we have integrations with Slack and Google Calendar. You'll get notifications in Slack and tasks can appear in your calendar. Client: How much does it cost? Presenter: We have a free plan for small teams and paid plans for larger teams. You can find more details on our website. Presenter: Let me also show you the progress tracking feature. You can see a visual board of your tasks. You can drag and drop tasks to update their status. Client: Very impressive. Thank you for the demo!

enonce.texte:
You have been asked to present a live demo of a weather app called 'SkyCast'. The app has the following features:

  • Real-time weather updates for any city
  • 7-day forecast
  • Interactive map with weather layers
  • Customizable alerts for severe weather

Write a 5-minute demo script that includes:

  • An introduction to the app and its purpose
  • A step-by-step walkthrough of the key features
  • A demonstration of the interactive map
  • A conclusion and summary

questions.reponse: Hello everyone. Today I'm excited to show you SkyCast, our new weather application. SkyCast provides real-time weather updates for any city in the world, along with a 7-day forecast and an interactive map. Let me start by entering a city name. I'll type 'London' and press enter. As you can see, we get the current temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather conditions. The data updates every 5 minutes. Now let's look at the 7-day forecast. You can see a summary of the weather for the next week, including highs, lows, and precipitation chances. Now let me show you the interactive map. You can zoom in and out, and click on any location to get the weather there. You can also toggle different layers like satellite, radar, and temperature. This is very useful for planning travel or events. Finally, you can set up custom alerts. For example, you can get a notification when the temperature drops below 10°C or when rain is expected. In conclusion, SkyCast is a powerful and user-friendly weather app. It gives you all the information you need to plan your day. Thank you for your attention.
